Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — FintechProspect evaluation

Hi Emily / Daniel,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciate the candid discussion about your ML ops and inference requirements. As promised, attached is a concise recap of what we demoed and a proposed POC evaluation plan to help you validate fit quickly. High-level recap: 

- Demo highlights: real-time chat demo, embeddings search example for transaction QA, and a short walkthrough of our Redwood Optimize recommendations for cost/latency.
- Key value props you called out: predictable latency under burst, on-prem/private deployment option, and fine-grained cost visibility per route.

Proposed POC (summary) — attached as "POC_EvalPlan_v1.pdf":
1) Success criteria (what we measure):
   - Latency: 95th percentile latency <= 250ms for 256-token requests under your baseline load.
   - Cost: demonstrable cost improvement (tokens / request) vs. current setup or clear unit-cost forecast with our recommendations.
   - Quality: sample prompt set evaluation where F1 / relevance meets your threshold (we'll use your sample intents).
   - Integration: ability to route traffic from your staging environment to Redwood with no change to your client SDKs.
2) Evaluation plan / steps:
   - Week 0: Data & security intake (sample prompts, schema, and allowlist) + account provisioning.
   - Week 1: Test environment & baseline run (we deploy a dedicated dev instance or private cluster as agreed).
   - Weeks 2-3: Load & quality runs, telemetry collection, and tune (batching/cache + quantization profile).
   - Week 4: Final evaluation report and next-step recommendation.
3) Ownership / contacts:
   - You: Emily (product) + Daniel (engineering) — sample data + success-criteria sign-off.
   - Redwood: Marissa (AE) for project management, Rishi (solutions) + Dylan (SRE/eng) for technical setup, Monica (CS) for onboarding.
4) Timeline & logistics: target ~4-week POC from intake to readout. Kickoff availability: next week; suggest Tue/Thu mornings PT.

Next steps:
- Please confirm the success criteria above and any internal approvals needed.
- If OK, can we schedule a 30-45 minute kickoff next week to agree access & sample data?

Attachments: POC_EvalPlan_v1.pdf (POC outline) + SOW_template.docx (baseline terms for review).

Thanks — happy to iterate on the plan to fit your timelines.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198
